उपोह् {c1c} P. (उप-उह्)
1 To propel,
push or impel towards; उपोह्य रुचिरां
नावं Rām.; so धनुः.
--2 To push under,
insert, कूर्चावधस्तादुपोह्य Kātyāyana.
--3 To bring near, produce:
connected with उपवह् in this sense;
q. v.
--4 To accumulate, collect.
